violations.text: No person in charge (with a certificate from a food safety managers course) was present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2026

Raw animal foods (such as chicken cutlets) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as chicken wings) in the prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2026

The following was observed in poor repair: 1) The reach-in freezer in the kitchen was observed with missing handles. 2) The gaskets of the pizza prep unit near the oven was observed with frayed gaskets. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine has an accumulation of black residue on the white guard. The non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned as often as necessary. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2026
Food debris was observed along the window/floor in the kitchen. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned: 1) The non-food contact surfaces of the mixer (above the attachments) were observed with food debris 2) The fan covers in the walk-in cooler were observed with an accumulation of dust New Violation. Correct By: 03/24/2026

One of the bays of the food prep sink was observed with an air-break. An approved backflow prevention device is required in order to prevent backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply at each point of use at a food establishment. New Violation. Correct By: 04/07/2026
